sources.summary: Meta released Astryx, an open-source React design system built on StyleX. It pairs a CSS-variable theme cascade with a CLI and MCP server, so both engineers and AI agents build using the same API. The project is in Beta, MIT-licensed, and grew inside Meta over eight years. The post Meta’s Astryx Brings a CLI and MCP Server to an Open-Source React Design System Agents Can Read appeared first on MarkTechPost .
